# AWS Config

Persist regional rule, recorder and delivery-channel metadata without resource capture, compliance evaluation or delivery.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `config` |
| Signing name | `config` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2014-11-12` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 16 of 102 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-config) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: recording=true represents requested control-plane state, not active resource capture; lastStatus and recording-event results are absent.
- Delivery status returns the channel name without history, snapshot or stream results; no S3/SNS writes, background delivery, compliance evaluation, Lambda invocation or remediation.
- CUSTOM_LAMBDA/CUSTOM_POLICY, SourceDetails, custom policy details, rule lifecycle state writes, MaximumExecutionFrequency and evaluation modes are unsupported.
- Service-linked recorders, recording modes/overrides, exclusion/recording strategies, connector fields and explicit resource types outside the four listed types are unsupported; allSupported is metadata only.
- KMS delivery, cross-account/Region SNS ARNs, FIFO SNS topics, aggregators, conformance packs, organization Config and external resource gathering are unsupported.
- Names are limited to letters, digits, hyphens and underscores (rules 1-128, recorder/channel 1-256); rule rename requires delete/create and singleton names cannot change until deletion.
- IAM role existence/trust, bucket policies and delivery permissions are not evaluated; destination bucket must already exist locally in the caller's account.
- CloudFormation omits Compliance, EvaluationModes, MaximumExecutionFrequency, recording modes, StartedOnCreate and KMS properties; no automatic start, capture or delivery. Explicit DependsOn is needed from channel to recorder.
- Delivery channels have no AWS resource ARN or tags; their metadata appears in generic inventory, while tag APIs support rules and recorders only; no mutation console pages.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
